D/ IMP CARAVSIVS [P F AVG] ; R/ [P]AX AVG

Copper alloy radiate of Carausius dated to AD 287-293 (Reece 14), PAX AVG, Pax standing left with branch and vertical sceptre. Unclear mint. Obverse description: Radiate, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP CARAVSIVS [P F AVG]. Reverse description: Pax standing left, holding branch and vertical sceptre.
